description: Any app's recent reviews in one storefront, newest first: stars, title, text, version and date, plus the star distribution of the rows returned. Reviewer names are left out. An app Hive does not hold yet is added on the first call.

appId.description: App Store id (e.g. 570060128) or Google Play package name

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

name: hive_app_reviews
